# iboss_security_group (Data Source)

Looks up one security (filtering) group by exact name or by number. Use its `group_number` with the allowlist and block list resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a group by its exact name...
data "iboss_security_group" "students" {
  name = "Students"
}

# ...or by number.
data "iboss_security_group" "default" {
  group_number = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group_number` (Number) Group number (`groupNumber`).
- `name` (String) Exact, case-sensitive group name (`groupName`). Exactly one of `name` or `group_number` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The group number.
- `note` (String) Group note (`note`).
- `parent_group_number` (Number) Parent group number (`parentGroupNumber`).
- `priority` (Number) Group priority (`priority`).
- `reporting_group_number` (Number) Reporting group number (`reportingGroupNumber`).
- `reserved` (Boolean) Whether the group is reserved (`reservedGroup`).
